title: AnalyticsEvent
description: analytics/event.v1: one raw analytics event (ADR-021). Kept by the owning service for at most 30 days, then only its rollups (daily and hourly counts) remain. It never carries an IP address, a user or subject id, a precise location (region or city), a raw user agent, a full referer URL, or a URL with ids or a query string. Requests sent with `Sec-GPC: 1` or `DNT: 1` produce no event. openvibe-shared/analytics stores it as an analytics_events row. For compatibility that row keeps the retired columns ip, user_id and city, always NULL; event.toEvent(row) maps a row to this shape.

event.description: Event name: 'pageview' and 'api_call' for HTTP requests, or a custom name given to trackEvent. Row column: event_type.

service.description: The recording service, for example 'live', 'openvibe-network' or 'openvibe-yt'.

route.description: The route template, such as '/api/vods/:id/comments' or '/@:user'. It is the matched Express route, or else the request path with ids, usernames and slugs replaced by parameters. It has no query or fragment, and it is null for a custom event without a path. Row column: path.

method.description: HTTP method, or null for a custom event.

status.description: HTTP status code. Row column: status_code.

duration_ms.description: Time from the request's arrival to the finished response, in milliseconds. Row column: response_time_ms.

session_id.description: A rotating session id: 16 random hex characters. It is renewed after 30 minutes idle and at every UTC midnight, and it is never derived from, or equal to, a user id. It is null when no session applies.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code taken from the CDN header, or null. This is the only geography kept.

ua_class.description: User-agent class: '<browser>/<os>/<device>', 'bot:<family>' for a known crawler, or 'none' when there is no user agent. The raw user agent is never stored. Row column: user_agent.

referer_origin.description: The scheme://host[:port] of an http(s) referer, or null. Never its path or query. Row column: referer.

is_bot.description: True for a known crawler, a missing user agent, a honeypot path, or a client over the request-rate threshold.

bot_type.description: Why the event is a bot hit: known_crawler, no_useragent, honeypot_hit or rate_limit. A custom event may give its own value.

authenticated.description: Whether the request was signed in. This is a flag and never says who.

timestamp.description: UTC time in RFC 3339 form with second precision. Row column: created_at, stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' UTC.
